where: Golden late afternoon on the Kordavos docks: a broad cobbled quay along the harbour, the tall elven ship Star of Faelendar moored at it with a gangway to her deck, a treadwheel crane and stacks of cargo beside her, stone warehouses with arcades and stalls along the back of the quay, and Warehouse 14, a timber shed, in the shadowed corner at its west end. The party has come along the quay. Ahead by the cargo stacks, a grizzled dockworker in a leather apron has set down a crate and eyes them, a huge tattooed dockworker and a dock hand with a pipe beside him.

cast.name: A dock hand with a pipe
